activation: output of model.layers[27] before the final norm, bf16 forward, adapters unmerged

fit.solver: torch L-BFGS on the scikit-learn objective

displacement.beats_control_when: absolute value exceeds the 95th percentile of absolute shifts along the random directions

association_with_behavior.definition: Pearson r between per-prompt probe-gap shift and per-prompt compliance-gap shift, arm minus neutral adapter
association_with_behavior.runs: off the pod, needs judged rows

freeze_order: probe_freeze.json/.npz and hash written by `fit` before any adapter is loaded; `adapters` refuses without a verifying hash
